segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hello, thank you for contacting Apex Internet. My name is Jordan. How may I help you today?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Jordan. I have two problems. My email is bouncing and my static IP stopped working after last night's maintenance.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I see. Let me check both issues. First I will fix the email routing table — that's corrected now. Your mail should work again.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Oh good, yes email is back. What about the static IP? That one is critical for my business VPN.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: For the static IP reassignment I need to escalate to our network provisioning team. That ticket will take twenty-four to forty-eight hours unfortunately.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So the email is fixed but I still cannot use my VPN until next day or even the day after. That is going to cost me real money.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I completely understand the urgency. I have flagged it as high priority and you will receive an email update as soon as provisioning completes.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, I appreciate you fixing the email at least. I will wait for the IP ticket but I hope it is resolved quickly.

ground_truth.reason: Agent fixed the email issue immediately but could not resolve the static IP, making the call a partial resolution with the key business-critical issue still pending.

evidence.quote: For the static IP reassignment I need to escalate to our network provisioning team.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: ProServ billing department, this is Chloe speaking.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Chloe. I received an invoice for eight hundred dollars but my contract says my monthly fee is only four hundred. This has to be a billing error.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I can see that invoice and I agree something looks off. I am going to need to pull the contract amendment log which I cannot access from my current screen.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So what happens now? I cannot just let an eight hundred dollar charge sit on my account.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am placing a billing hold on that invoice right now so it will not auto-charge. A specialist will review the contract discrepancy and call you back within two business days.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Two business days? That is a long time. Can I get something in writing confirming the hold?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Absolutely. I am sending you a confirmation email right now with the hold reference number and the callback window.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Got the email. Alright, I will wait for the callback then. Thank you for placing that hold.

ground_truth.reason: Agent placed a billing hold and promised a specialist callback within two days but did not resolve the billing discrepancy during the call.

evidence.quote: A specialist will review the contract discrepancy and call you back within two business days.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: SecureBank fraud line, this is Marcus.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes hello, I want to dispute a charge on my checking account. My account number is 8830045.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I can help with that. For security I need to verify your identity. Can you please confirm the last four digits of your social security number?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Sure, it is 4471. The account name is Patterson.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am sorry, the information you provided does not match our records for that account number. I cannot proceed without passing identity verification.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Wait, let me check my card. Oh no, I may have given you my old account number by mistake. My new one ends in 0091.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I have located that account and the details do match now. Would you like me to continue with the dispute for the charge on this account?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes please, I apologize for the confusion with the account number.

ground_truth.reason: Customer provided wrong account number initially; agent correctly refused to proceed until authentication passed and then restarted the dispute process, but it was not completed on this call.

evidence.quote: I have located that account and the details do match now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Global Mobility support, this is Diana.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hello yes. I am calling for my... how to say... my phone plan. I have problem. Data not working. I am from Brazil, sorry my English is not so good.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: No problem at all, take your time. Can you tell me your phone number so I can look up your account?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes, the number is... sorry I need look my phone... it is 617-555-0192. The data, it say roaming but I am home now three weeks.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I see your account. Your phone is still set to international roaming mode from your previous trip. I will toggle that off now and reset the data connection.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Sorry, I not understand. You... fix it now? The internet will work now on my phone?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, I fixed it right now. Please restart your phone and your data should work normally without extra roaming charges.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Oh! I restart now... yes! It is working! Thank you so much. I am very happy now. Sorry again for my English.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Your English is just fine! I am glad we got it sorted. You are all set.

ground_truth.reason: Agent patiently worked through a language barrier to identify and fix a stuck roaming mode, fully resolving the data issue.

evidence.quote: I fixed it right now. Please restart your phone and your data should work normally without extra roaming charges.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: HealthPlus member services, this is Ryan.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Finally! I have been on hold for forty-five minutes. Forty-five minutes! I just want to know why my prescription was denied.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I sincerely apologize for the wait time. That is completely unacceptable. Let me pull up your prescription denial record right away.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I see the denial. It was flagged because your doctor submitted the prior authorization form using an outdated code. This is a fixable error.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So I sat on hold forty-five minutes for a paperwork code error that your system caught but nobody told me or my doctor about?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: You are absolutely right and I am so sorry. I am contacting your doctor's office right now to send the updated prior auth form. This should be re-processed within twenty-four hours.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Fine. But someone should have called us before making me wait this long. This is a blood pressure medication. It is not optional.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I completely agree. I have also added an expedite flag to your account so this is reviewed first thing tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay. I appreciate you at least sorting it out now. I hope it gets fixed tomorrow.

ground_truth.reason: Agent identified the fixable prior-auth code error and initiated reprocessing, but the prescription was not yet approved by the end of the call.

evidence.quote: I am contacting your doctor's office right now to send the updated prior auth form.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: TechStore support, I am Felix.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Felix. I ordered a laptop last Thursday and the website says it has shipped but the tracking number you emailed does not work on FedEx.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Let me check your order. I see order 77234 shipped on Friday. The tracking number should be 794644782500. Let me verify that... actually wait, I misread. That is not your tracking number.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, so what is the correct one?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: My apologies for that error. The correct FedEx tracking number for your order is 794644790817. I have just re-sent the confirmation email with the corrected number.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I got the new email. Let me try the tracking number... yes it works! Shows out for delivery today.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Excellent! Delivery should be by end of day. I apologize for the initial confusion with the tracking number.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: No worries, thanks for catching your own mistake and fixing it quickly. Appreciate the honesty.

ground_truth.reason: Agent caught and corrected their own tracking number error mid-call, sent the corrected details, and the customer confirmed the order is out for delivery.

evidence.quote: The correct FedEx tracking number for your order is 794644790817.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Sunrise Energy customer care, this is Amara.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Amara. I have two things. First my smart thermostat lost connection to your cloud service, and second I think I was double-billed for my solar export credits last month.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I will start with the thermostat. I can see it dropped from the cloud at 2 AM on the fourth. I am pushing a remote re-pairing command now.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: The thermostat just reconnected, the app shows it online again. Great. Now the billing issue?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: For the solar export credits I need to request a billing audit. The export metering logs from your smart meter take forty-eight hours to pull. I cannot adjust the bill today.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So the thermostat is fixed but the billing thing is still up in the air? How much are we talking about if I was double-billed?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: It could be up to sixty dollars if the export credits were applied twice. I have opened audit ticket SR-4492 and you will be notified by email within seventy-two hours.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay. I am glad the thermostat is sorted. Sixty dollars is not nothing so please make sure that audit goes through.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Absolutely, I have escalated it as a priority billing dispute. You will hear back before end of week.

ground_truth.reason: The thermostat reconnection issue was fixed immediately but the double-billing dispute requires a 48-hour audit and could not be resolved on the call.

evidence.quote: For the solar export credits I need to request a billing audit.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: CloudDrive support, this is Priya.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Priya. I have been waiting for thirty minutes. I just want to reset my two-factor authentication because I got a new phone and I am completely locked out of my work account.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I understand that is urgent. I need to verify your identity before resetting two-factor. Can you provide your employee ID and the email address on file?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: My employee ID is E10394 and my work email is t.wright at datacore dot io.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Those match. I have reset your two-factor authentication. You will receive a text message to your new phone within two minutes with the setup link.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Got the text. Setting up now... it is working. Thank goodness. That thirty-minute wait was rough but you sorted it quickly.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am glad we got you back in. I apologize again for the wait time.

ground_truth.reason: Despite long hold-time frustration, agent quickly verified identity and reset two-factor authentication, fully restoring account access.

evidence.quote: I have reset your two-factor authentication.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: RetailMax returns center, Kenji speaking. How can I help?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I returned a treadmill three weeks ago and I only got a partial refund. I paid 1200 dollars but I only got 900 back. That 300 dollar gap is not explained anywhere.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I see your return on file. The 300 dollar deduction is a restocking fee applied because the packaging was opened and the belt showed minor use marks under the return policy.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That is ridiculous. I used it for two days and the motor made a grinding sound so I returned it. A defective product should not have a restocking fee.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That is a very fair point. If the product was defective the restocking fee should be waived. I am going to escalate this to our quality returns team with a defective product flag.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So am I getting the 300 dollars back or not? I need a clear answer.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I cannot approve the refund myself but the quality team should contact you within five business days and if the defect is confirmed the 300 will be refunded.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Fine. Five days. But if they try to deny it again I am disputing with my credit card company.

ground_truth.reason: Agent correctly flagged the defective-product exception but could not authorize the 300 dollar restocking fee refund, leaving the customer frustrated and threatening a chargeback.

evidence.quote: I cannot approve the refund myself but the quality team should contact you within five business days.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: FlexNet outage response, this is Samantha.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi. I called yesterday about my fiber being down and was promised a callback within four hours. It has now been eighteen hours and nobody called me.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I sincerely apologize for the missed callback. I can see your case in the system. The outage in your area was resolved at 6 AM this morning. Is your service working now?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Actually yes, it came back this morning. But I still did not get a callback and I had to work offline all day yesterday.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: We failed to call you back as promised, and that is on us. I am applying a twenty dollar service credit to your next bill for the downtime inconvenience.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay, thank you for the credit. The internet is working now so I suppose we are good.

ground_truth.reason: Service had already been restored before the callback call; agent confirmed resolution and applied a service credit for the missed callback promise.

evidence.quote: I am applying a twenty dollar service credit to your next bill for the downtime inconvenience.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: SmartHome support, this is Luis.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Luis. My smart doorbell camera stopped recording at night and my smart lock keeps showing offline in the app even though it locks and unlocks fine.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Let me check the camera first. I can see the night vision mode was disabled by the last firmware update. I have re-enabled it remotely and pushed a settings sync.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: The camera app now shows night recording is on. Does that mean it is fixed?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes it should record tonight. Now for the smart lock, the offline status is a known display bug in app version 3.1. Updating the app to 3.2 will fix the status indicator.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Updating now... okay it is at 3.2. And yes the lock shows online and green in the app now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Both issues are resolved. The camera will record at night and the lock status will display correctly going forward.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That was easier than I expected. Thank you for sorting both of them out so quickly Luis.

ground_truth.reason: Agent resolved both the camera night-vision disable and the smart-lock display bug within the same call with no unresolved issues remaining.

evidence.quote: Both issues are resolved.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: MobileOne plan changes, this is Daria.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi. I called last week and the agent switched me to the sixty dollar unlimited plan but my bill this month shows eighty dollars.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Let me review the account notes. I see the change was applied... wait, I am reading the wrong account tier. Let me re-check. Ah, the previous agent applied the premium eighty dollar plan, not the sixty dollar one. That was our error.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So I was put on the wrong plan and charged twenty dollars more than I agreed to?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That is correct and I apologize. I am switching you to the sixty dollar plan right now effective today, and I am issuing a twenty dollar credit to correct this month's overcharge.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay. So next month I will see sixty dollars plus the twenty credit applied?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Exactly. Your next bill will be forty dollars reflecting the plan correction and the credit. I have confirmed both changes in the system.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Alright, thank you for catching that and fixing it. I just hope this does not happen again.

ground_truth.reason: Agent self-corrected after initially reading the wrong account tier, identified the previous agent error, applied the correct plan, and issued a credit for the overcharge.

evidence.quote: I am switching you to the sixty dollar plan right now effective today, and I am issuing a twenty dollar credit to correct this month's overcharge.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Meridian insurance claims, I am Owen.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes hello. I need to make... uh... I have accident with my car. I want to... how to say... make the claim. Sorry I not speak English very good.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I understand you want to file a car accident claim. Do you have your policy number handy?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes I have it... MP... wait this is credit card. One moment please. I look in email. I cannot find it now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: No problem. Can I look it up by your name and date of birth instead?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: My name is... Luciana Ferriera. Born twelve March nineteen eighty-five. In Europe format it is twelve-three-eighty-five.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I have found your policy. Unfortunately to file a full claim I need a police report number which you would get from the accident report. Do you have that?

ground_truth.reason: Agent located the policy but could not complete the claim without a police report number, and the call ended without enough information to file.

evidence.quote: to file a full claim I need a police report number which you would get from the accident report.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Nexus account security, I am Hugo.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi. My account has been locked. I have tried the self-service reset three times and it just loops back. I need someone to unlock it manually.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I can help with a manual unlock. To protect your account I need to ask a few verification questions. What is your mother's maiden name as registered on the account?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: It should be Calderon.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That does not match. I have one more question. What was the first street address you registered with us?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Twelve Maple Avenue. Wait, or was it Elm? I moved a lot. Try Twelve Elm Street.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am sorry, neither answer matches our records. I cannot unlock the account over the phone for security reasons. You will need to visit a branch with a government-issued photo ID.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That is really inconvenient but I understand you cannot just give access without verification. Which branch is closest to zip code 02115?

ground_truth.reason: Customer failed two security questions so the agent correctly declined to unlock the account remotely and directed them to an in-person branch visit.

evidence.quote: I cannot unlock the account over the phone for security reasons.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: ValueAir reservations, this is Tomas.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I have been on hold for an hour. An hour! I need to change my flight for tomorrow because there is a family emergency. Can you please just help me quickly?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am so sorry for the wait. Absolutely, I can change your flight. Can you give me your booking reference?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: It is VAX8821. I need to move from the 10 AM to either the 6 AM or the noon flight tomorrow.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I have your booking. The 6 AM is sold out but the noon flight has availability. I can move you at no change fee given the family emergency circumstances.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Yes please, noon is perfect. Thank you so much.

ground_truth.reason: Despite extreme hold-time frustration, agent waived the change fee and moved the customer to the noon flight, fully resolving the emergency rebooking.

evidence.quote: I can move you at no change fee given the family emergency circumstances.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Metro Water billing, this is Sharon.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Sharon. I have two issues. My bill this month is triple the normal amount, and a new service fee appeared that I have never seen before and nobody told me about.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Let me pull up your account. The high bill is flagged for a meter reading audit, which typically takes five to seven business days. I cannot adjust it until the audit completes.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: What about the mystery service fee? What even is that?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That is a new infrastructure maintenance levy added by the city council last month. All accounts in your district received it. I do not have authority to waive it.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So I have a potentially wrong triple bill that you cannot fix for a week, plus a new fee nobody told me about that you also cannot remove. What exactly can you do?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I can place a payment hold on your account so nothing auto-charges while the meter audit is pending. The new levy unfortunately is non-negotiable as it is a city mandate.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Put the hold on. This is really frustrating. Neither problem is actually solved today.

ground_truth.reason: Agent placed a payment hold but neither the high bill nor the new fee was resolved during the call, leaving the customer frustrated.

evidence.quote: I can place a payment hold on your account so nothing auto-charges while the meter audit is pending.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: GigaCloud technical support, this is Elena.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi. I got a callback from your team but the agent told me to reinstall the app to fix my sync issue. I did it and now I lost all my local drafts. They are gone.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am so sorry that happened. Reinstalling should not remove drafts — they should sync from the cloud backup. Let me check if your drafts folder still exists on our servers.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I can see your drafts folder on the server side. They were not deleted. The reinstall disconnected the local sync. I will re-link your account to that folder now.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: My drafts folder is showing up again in the app! All thirty-two drafts are there. Oh thank goodness.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I also want to note that the previous agent gave you incorrect instructions. Reinstalling was not necessary for a sync issue. I am filing an internal feedback report for that.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: I appreciate you being honest about that. I am just relieved my work is not lost. Thank you Elena.

ground_truth.reason: Agent recovered the drafts by relinking the cloud sync, acknowledged the previous agent error, and filed internal feedback, fully resolving the issue.

evidence.quote: I will re-link your account to that folder now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: OrderHub customer care, I am Derek.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi. I ordered three items in one package. The box arrived but one item is missing and one item arrived broken. The third one is fine.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I am sorry about that. For the broken item I can process an immediate replacement shipment — that will arrive in two days. Which item was broken?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: The ceramic mug. The replacement would be great. What about the missing headphones?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The headphones show as shipped in the same package. We need to open a trace with the carrier for the missing item. That investigation takes three to five business days.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So the mug replacement is coming in two days but the headphones might take a week or more to sort out?

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: That is correct. If the carrier trace confirms the headphones were lost we will ship a replacement immediately. I have initiated both the mug replacement and the carrier trace.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Okay. At least the mug is coming quickly. The headphones situation is frustrating but I understand it takes time to investigate.

ground_truth.reason: The broken mug replacement was dispatched immediately but the missing headphones require a carrier trace that could take up to five days to resolve.

evidence.quote: the headphones might take a week or more to sort out

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: PrimeFin card services, I am Tobias.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hi Tobias. My card got blocked while I was traveling and I need it unblocked. I am at the airport right now and cannot pay for anything.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I can try to unblock your card. First I need to verify your identity. Can you confirm the full card number, expiry, and the name printed on the card?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Card is 4532 0151 1283 0366, expiry 03-28, name is Adrian Kovacs.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: The card number and expiry match. I see the block was triggered by a foreign transaction flag. I have removed the travel block. Your card should work now.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Let me try it at the coffee shop here... it worked! Thank you so much Tobias, you just saved me at the airport.

ground_truth.reason: Agent verified identity with card details, identified a travel block, removed it immediately, and customer confirmed the card works.

evidence.quote: I have removed the travel block. Your card should work now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Urban Utilities, this is Grace.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: Hello. I speak little English. I have problem with... the hot water. No hot water in my apartment. Two days now. I am in building 14 in apartment 302.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I understand, no hot water for two days. That is urgent. Can I have your account number or the name on the account?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: The name is... Miroslava Horvatova. I not sure account number. Maybe my husband knows but he is working now.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I found the account by address. There is a known boiler fault affecting your building since yesterday. The repair crew is scheduled for this afternoon between two and five PM.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: So today afternoon they come? Two to five? Okay I understand. I wait at home. Thank you Grace, I understand now what happen.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Yes, two to five PM today. If they do not arrive by five please call us back and we will escalate. I am adding a priority note to your account right now.

ground_truth.reason: Agent identified a known building boiler fault and communicated the afternoon repair window, but the hot water was not restored during the call.

evidence.quote: The repair crew is scheduled for this afternoon between two and five PM.
